title: Christmas with the Kranks
tagline: Skipping Christmas? Not with this ham.
about: A couple try to skip Christmas for a cruise until their daughter says she is coming home after all.
cue: Serve the main when the neighbours rally round for the Christmas Eve party.

Krank Family KitchenChristmas with the KranksSkipping Christmas? Not with this ham.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersRooftop snowman cheese ballCheddar and cream cheese ball rolled in mozzarella, with crackersHow to make it375g cream cheese, soft150g cheddar, grated1 small bunch chives, chopped1/2 tsp garlic powder100g mozzarella, finely grated1 jar pitted black olives1 carrot1 bag pretzel sticks250g crackersBeat the cream cheese with the cheddar, chives and garlic powder.Chill the mixture.Shape into one large and one small ball, roll both in the mozzarella and stack on a platter.Press in sliced olives for eyes and buttons, a small carrot stick for the nose and pretzel sticks for arms.Chill until serving and surround with crackers.Caribbean cruise prawn cocktailCooked king prawns with lime and a hot sauce Marie RoseHow to make it600g cooked king prawns150g mayonnaise3 tbsp tomato sauce2 limeshot sauce, a few drops1 tsp Worcestershire sauce1 baby cos lettuce1 avocado, cubed1/2 tsp paprikaPeel the prawns, leaving the tails on.Mix the mayonnaise with the tomato sauce, juice of one lime, hot sauce and Worcestershire.Shred the lettuce into glasses and add cubes of avocado.Spoon over the sauce and hang the prawns around the rims. Dust with paprika and serve with lime wedges.MainsNora's last honey glazed hamClove studded leg ham glazed with honey, brown sugar and DijonHow to make it2.5kg half leg ham1 tbsp cloves120ml honey60g brown sugar2 tbsp Dijon mustard100ml pineapple juice1kg potatoes, halved3 tbsp vegetable oil1/2 pineapple, diced1 red chilli, diced1 small bunch mint1 lime, juicedRemove the rind from the ham, score the fat and stud with cloves.Simmer the honey, sugar, mustard and pineapple juice until syrupy.Bake the ham at 180°C, brushing with glaze every so often. Roast the potatoes in oil alongside.Toss the pineapple, chilli, mint and lime juice for the salsa.Slice the ham and serve with the salsa.Christmas Eve party green beansBrown butter, toasted almonds and lemon. Vic Frohmeyer will checkHow to make it500g green beans, trimmed50g butter40g flaked almonds1 lemonTrim the beans and zest the lemon.Boil the beans in salted water until just tender, then drain.Melt the butter in a frying pan and cook until it smells nutty and turns golden. Add the almonds and toast.Toss the beans through the brown butter with the lemon zest, a squeeze of juice and salt.SweetsLast-minute Christmas Eve trifleSponge, orange juice, berries, jelly, custard, cream and almondsHow to make it1 packet raspberry jelly crystals300g sponge cake100ml orange juice300g mixed berries, plus a few extra to finish600ml thick vanilla custard300ml thickened cream1 tbsp icing sugar30g flaked almonds, toastedMake up the jelly with boiling water.Break the sponge into a large glass bowl and drizzle with orange juice. Scatter over the berries.Pour the cooled jelly over and chill until set.Spoon the custard on top.Whip the cream with the icing sugar and spread over. Finish with almonds and a few berries.DrinksHemlock Street cranberry fizz punchCranberry and orange juice punch with ginger ale, rosemary and berriesHow to make it1 L cranberry juice500ml orange juice2 limes, juiced2 sprigs of rosemary1 L cold ginger ale1 orange, sliced100g frozen cranberries or raspberries1 bag iceMix the cranberry juice, orange juice and lime juice in a punch bowl. Add the rosemary.Chill.Just before serving, add the ginger ale, orange slices, frozen berries and plenty of ice. Stir gently.Ladle into glasses with a little rosemary in each.
